meta.description: ORVIBO Smart Lock V5: AI 3D face recognition that unlocks in a second, a 1080P/165° video peephole with a 4-inch indoor screen, whole-home automation, dual power for up to 365 days, and finishes in walnut, marble, leather and obsidian.
sec2.title: 8 strengths of smart design
sec2.note2: *1080P/165° video peephole: the viewing angle is the lens’s diagonal; lenses differ slightly, so the actual angle may vary a little.
sec2.note3: Whole-home automation: requires other ORVIBO products.
sec2.note4: Up to 3 years of replacement instead of repair: every order of the ORVIBO V5 Face smart lock includes a one-year replace-not-repair warranty worth ¥199. The Lock Care service extends it to three years of replacement instead of repair.
sec2.note5: What replacement instead of repair covers: if a quality defect makes the product fail or work poorly, and customer service confirms it is a quality defect, the product is replaced rather than repaired.
sec2.note6: (The service does not cover a wrongly ordered model, cosmetic issues or damage caused by the customer; Shenzhen ORVIBO Technology Co., Ltd. has the final say on its terms.)
sec2.note7: Dual power, 365 days per charge: with the lithium battery and the dry cells together, the lock runs for over 365 days. Data from ORVIBO’s lab.
sec3.sec3_title: AI 3D face recognition: unlocked in 1 second
sec4.sec4_content: A premium automotive-grade binocular camera with a new-generation AI edge processor and a 2 MP HD 3D sensor. Two liveness-detection algorithms, infrared and stereo, run side by side, and every unlock captures your face afresh, so recognition grows more accurate the more you use it.
sec4.row_item_content: Tilted up 10° with an 85° wide view, it recognizes faces turned up to 40° and people from 1.2 m to 2.0 m tall.
sec4.row_item_content2: An active AI fill light: accurate even in a dark stairwell.
sec4.row_item_content3: Makeup, glasses, a hat: it still recognizes you accurately.
sec4.sec4_tips: * Figures above are from ORVIBO’s lab.
sec5.sec5_title: 1080P/165° video peephole, full color day and night
sec6.sec6_title1: 4-inch IPS HD indoor screen: see clearly, rest easy
sec6.sec6_title2: Indoors, a 4-inch IPS HD screen renders images faithfully, with fine gradations of color, so you can see clearly what happens outside your door.
sec7.title: Smart and beautiful: bespoke art for your door
sec7.desc: Inspired by nature, the panels take on the textures of walnut, marble or leather: bespoke art for your door that shows your own taste.
sec9_video.title: Biomimetic curves for a comfortable grip
sec9.sec9_title1: Dual power, taking turns for long battery life
sec9.sec9_title2: A large 5,000 mAh lithium battery (7.4 V) plus 6 AA backup batteries power the lock in turn; while the lithium battery charges, the backups take over seamlessly.
sec9.battery3: Emergency power from a power bank
sec9.battery_note2: ③ On the backup batteries, the lock still unlocks, but the peephole camera and the large screen don’t work.
sec9.sec10_title: Whole-home automation: peace of mind as you come and go
sec9.sec11_title: Video intercom in every room: unlock from anywhere with one tap
sec9.sec12_item_title:
3rd-gen ultra-quiet lock body
never disturbs the family
sec9.sec12_item_content: A fully automatic lock body with planetary gears locks and unlocks at under 60 dB. Turn off the prompt tones too, and coming or going never disturbs the family.
sec9.sec12_item_title2:
Easy-fit anti-pinch guard
left or right, your choice
sec9.sec12_item_content2: A single easy-fit guard plate mounts on either the left or the right of the lock.
sec9.sec12_item_title3:
Phone-grade one-piece IML film
clean, crisp good looks
sec9.sec12_item_content3: A panel that resists fingerprints, scratches, dirt and corrosion.
sec9.sec13_title: 8 ways to unlock, each one easy
sec9.sec13_tips:
⑤ Unlock from a second screen: a MixPad smart screen on the same family account and router as the lock can answer visitors and open the door.
⑥ Unlock with a phone or watch: Android phones and watches can emulate an NFC or access card; once it is enrolled, the phone or watch opens the door. Brands differ, so results may vary by model.
